body.description: Detect open roles across your accounts from public ATS boards, then turn each hiring signal into a concrete outreach angle — pushed to your webhook.
body.name: Hiring-signals radar

columns.name: Outreach angle
columns.prompt:
ROLE: You are a B2B sales strategist.
CONTEXT: Company: {company}. Open roles / hiring signals: {hiring_signals}.
TASK: From these hiring signals, infer ONE concrete business initiative the company is likely running, and phrase it as an outreach angle (why now).
FORMAT: One sentence, max 25 words.
FALLBACK: If there are no hiring signals, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

workbook.description: ats_hiring reads public ATS boards (zero-key); jobspy aggregates job portals as fallback. The AI column converts raw postings into an angle you can open with, and the webhook column notifies your own systems.
